trigger.symptom: 6 mult-d-grid runs completed training and held-out scoring (Beaker exit 0, logs end "All done, goodbye", committed disrnn-output-* and *-heldoutper_subject_likelihood run_table artifacts) but sit at W&B state=='crashed' with NO heldout/eval_likelihood key at all -- scaling_report.py's state=='finished' filter silently dropped these cells.
trigger.cause: Each run was preempted several times; the FINAL summary write after the held-out stage was dropped by a W&B heartbeat timeout, so the run object froze at a mid-training step with no held-out key. Beaker autoResume never retried because the task itself exited 0 -- only the metric write was lost.

deviations.method: heldout/eval_likelihood recomputed as the trial-weighted geometric mean of the committed per-subject likelihood table -- a pure function of data already logged, not a re-score. Validated against 5 independent runs with both the table and a natively-logged scalar before use.
